title: [LOGGED OUT] Hero area shows the three download badges with the right link targets

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/ in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Banner shown; clicked Dismiss; banner gone (screenshot retaken after the closing animation).

steps.text: Are the "Download on the App Store", "GET IT ON Google Play" and "GET IT ON Web-Version" badges shown below the big LUDUS logo?
steps.saw: Three badges shown in a row below the LUDUS logo: App Store, Google Play, Web-Version.

steps.text: Does the App Store badge point to https://apps.apple.com/ae/app/ludus-strategy-card-rpg-battle/id6446642912 (read the link target, do not open it)?
Does the Google Play badge point to https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.studion.mergearena&hl=en&pli=1?
Does the Web-Version badge point to https://ludus-game.com/game?
Do all three badges open in a new tab (target "_blank")?
steps.saw: All three hero badge links have target=_blank.
